trends.insight: Shoppers trade mass candy for premium bakery boxes during record spending.
trends.move: Stock fresh party boxes for counter pickup through Saturday afternoon.
trends.name: Halloween Bakery Treat Rush
trends.risk: Window closes strictly on October 31 as festivities end.
trends.what: NRF reports Halloween retail spend reaching $13.5 billion with surging appetite for bakery-quality treats.
trends.why_us: Our $18 Box of 6 gives Brooklyn hosts a premium upgrade over grocery candy.

trends.insight: Rival store closures and deep discounts highlight customer fatigue with mass gimmicks.
trends.move: Film unedited oven tray pulls celebrating real ingredients and uncompromised sizing.
trends.name: Fast-Bake Value Fatigue
trends.risk: Coming across as petty if we name rivals directly.
trends.what: Crumbl shuttered 57 stores and rolled out 99-cent items to combat declining foot traffic.
trends.why_us: We hold full price and highlight small-batch craft right from our Brooklyn counter.

trends.insight: Festive gifting shifts from mass mithai boxes toward premium craft bakery selections.
trends.move: Introduce online festive gift band positioning boxes for Diwali hospitality.
trends.name: Diwali Artisanal Gift Hampers
trends.risk: Shipping cutoff requires immediate ordering for on-time arrival.
trends.what: Gift guides spotlight gourmet bakes and luxury food boxes for Diwali celebrations on November 8.
trends.why_us: Our Box of 6 and Holiday Box of 12 offer beautifully packaged host gifts.

trends.insight: Commercial shelf-stable holiday cookies flood supermarket aisles months ahead of winter holidays.
trends.move: Position warm bakery pickup as the antidote to months-old grocery shelf boxes.
trends.name: Grocery Cookie Seasonal Rollout
trends.risk: Shoppers buying early convenience over fresh bakery quality.
trends.what: Tate's Bake Shop launched 2 holiday flavours nationwide in grocery aisles across the country.
trends.why_us: Factory cookies in plastic cannot replicate warm brown butter aroma from local ovens.

trends.insight: Audiences embrace classic harvest flavours as comforting seasonal temperatures cool.
trends.move: Feature warm spiced snickerdoodles alongside hot cider on social channels.
trends.name: Orchard Fruit Fall Comfort
trends.risk: Crowded recipe landscape across lifestyle food media.
trends.what: Bon Appétit published 43 apple dessert features highlighting caramel, spice, and orchard fruits.
trends.why_us: Pairs perfectly with our Pumpkin Spice Snickerdoodle as mid-fall afternoon treats.

trends.insight: Retailers and media begin publishing holiday merchandise guides over a month in advance.
trends.move: Finalize December shipping schedules and prepare Hanukkah box packaging assets.
trends.name: Early Hanukkah Gifting Spotlights
trends.risk: Pushing December holiday boxes before Halloween confuses current retail buyers.
trends.what: Disney and national outlets unveiled Hanukkah gift collections 39 days before first candle.
trends.why_us: Our Holiday Box of 12 serves December gatherings once festive gifting officially opens.

trends.insight: High-profile NYC cookie peers expand physical locations to West Coast high-end hubs.
trends.move: Keep eyes on their retail footprint while focusing on local neighborhood warmth.
trends.name: Craft Bakery Geographic Expansion
trends.risk: Irrelevant to everyday New York and online gift shoppers.
trends.what: Levain confirmed plans for its first Northern California outpost at Santana Row in 2027.
trends.why_us: Reinforces pride in our intimate, fiercely local Brooklyn neighborhood kitchen counter.

trends.insight: Sustainability coverage explores converting leftover bakery goods into new food products.
trends.move: Monitor zero-waste baking chatter but avoid altering core cookie recipes.
trends.name: Upcycled Bakery Food Trends
trends.risk: Baking cookies from bread crumbs does not match our premium product.
trends.what: Food publications covered store-bought pasta created from leftover surplus artisan bread.
trends.why_us: We bake small batches daily to order, preventing excess inventory naturally.

trends.insight: Mass media obsesses over multi-million dollar Hollywood celebrity party costumes.
trends.move: Ignore celebrity costumes completely; keep our feed focused on fresh cookies.
trends.name: Celebrity Halloween Costume Circus
trends.risk: Looking try-hard by meme-ing irrelevant red carpet outfits.
trends.what: Tabloids spotlight extreme costume reveals from Kardashian family members and musicians.
trends.why_us: Hollywood luxury stunts clash with our genuine Brooklyn counter voice.

trends.insight: Fast-food burger and donut chains flood feeds with free food promotions.
trends.move: Skip couponing races and highlight artisan value and genuine craftsmanship.
trends.name: Halloween Fast Food Freebies
trends.risk: Attracts bargain hunters who do not buy artisan bakery treats.
trends.what: National QSR chains roll out loss-leader coupons and free burgers for Halloween.
trends.why_us: We never discount cookies or devalue our ingredients with cheap gimmicks.
